name: aypo
description: Social, cultural, competitive and commerce intelligence for Southeast Asia

scripts.api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn aypo.main:app --reload --port ${AYPO_API_PORT:-8000}
scripts.worker: cd apps/api && uv run python -m aypo.jobs.worker
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run python -m aypo.db.migrate
